title: Tiwala 20 soybean: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Tiwala 20 soybean: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Tiwala 20 soybean is a grain soybean variety. About 83 days to harvest, 1.8 t/ha in trials. See its pest ratings and traits.
excerpt: Tiwala 20 soybean is a grain soybean variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2019 as NSIC 2019 Sy 15. It takes about 83 days from sowing to harvest, with 1.78 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

**Yield:** 1.78 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.
**Recommended for:** the areas in its trials, in the wet season.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Tiwala 20 soybean takes about 83 days from sowing to harvest. That is about the average of the 19 grain soybean varieties with a day count, 84.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 1.78 t/ha trails the average of its group, 1.92. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit soybean fields most often: [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A hundred seeds weigh about 12.8 grams, so the higher this number, the bigger the seed. The seed coat is yellow.
Where and when to plant Tiwala 20 soybean

It is recommended for the wet season. Grain soybean goes to feed and food processors, while vegetable soybean, or edamame, is picked green. Pick a variety rated against rust, the main soybean disease here.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 83 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 1.78 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Tiwala 20?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
